context: Migrated from a flat scenario file. Tests: Multi-Stage Build Optimisation (Stage 4/4).

checklist.name: Multi-stage build opportunity identified

checklist.name: Named AS build stage used

checklist.name: Minimal final base image chosen
checklist.description: Final stage uses `gcr.io/distroless/base-debian12`, `distroless/static`, or `alpine:3.x` rather than the full golang image

checklist.name: Image size reduction estimate provided

checklist.name: --target build debugging benefit explained
checklist.description: Agent explains that named stages allow `docker build --target build` to access the intermediate build stage for CI debugging without exposing the final runtime image

checklist.name: Security improvements noted
checklist.description: Agent notes that distroless images have no shell, package manager, or unnecessary system libraries, reducing the attack surface
